CREATE OR REPLACE Function Hrs_Get_Point(P_Doc_No_Ref Number,P_Doc_Srl_Ref Number) Return Number
V_Sam Number:=0;
V_Cnt Number:=0;
Begin
Select Nvl(Sum(Point_Cnt),0) Into V_Cnt
From Hrs_Job_Dsc_Exp D_Exp,Hrs_Cv_Exprnc_Info C_Exp,HRS_CV_JOB_SLCT Slct
Where D_Exp.Exp_Jb_No=C_Exp.Emp_Job_No
And Slct.Doc_No=C_Exp.Doc_No
And Slct.Emp_Job_No=D_Exp.Job_No
And Slct.Doc_No=P_Doc_No_Ref
And Slct.DOC_SRL_RQRMNT=P_Doc_Srl_Ref;
V_Sam:=V_Sam+V_Cnt;
Exception
When Others Then
Null;
End ;
From Hrs_Job_Dsc_Lng D_Lng,Hrs_Cv_Lng_Info C_Lng,HRS_CV_JOB_SLCT Slct
Where D_Lng.Lng_No=C_Lng.Lng_No
And Slct.Doc_No=C_Lng.Doc_No
And Slct.Emp_Job_No=D_Lng.Job_No
From Hrs_Job_Dsc_Qlf D_Qlf,Hrs_Cv_Qlfct_Info C_Qlf,HRS_CV_JOB_SLCT Slct
Where D_Qlf.Qlf_No=C_Qlf.Qlfctn_Strt_Wrk
And Slct.Doc_No=C_Qlf.Doc_No
And Slct.Emp_Job_No=D_Qlf.Job_No
From Hrs_Job_Dsc_Spc D_Spc,Hrs_Cv_Qlfct_Info C_Qlf,HRS_CV_JOB_SLCT Slct
Where D_Spc.Mjr_No=C_Qlf.Specialize
And Slct.Emp_Job_No=D_Spc.Job_No
Return V_Sam;
Return 0;
End Hrs_Get_Point;
Create Or Replace Function Validate_Emp_From_Db (P_Username In Varchar2, P_Password In Varchar2) Return Boolean As
C Number;
Select Count(1) Into C From S_Emp Where Upper(Emp_No) = Upper(P_Username) And Emp_Pswrd = P_Password;
If C>0 Then
Apex_Util.Set_Authentication_Result(0);
Return True;
Else
Apex_Util.Set_Authentication_Result(4);
Return False;
End If;
When No_Data_Found Then
Apex_Util.Set_Authentication_Result(1);
End Validate_Emp_From_Db;
Create Or Replace Function Validate_User_From_Db (P_Username In Varchar2, P_Password In Varchar2) Return Boolean As
C1 Number :=0;
Select Count(1) Into C1 From User_R Where Upper(U_Id) = Upper(P_Username);
If C1>0 Then
End Validate_User_From_Db;
Create Or Replace Function Get_Emp_Email(P_Emp_No S_Emp.Emp_No%Type) Return S_Emp.E_Mail%Type Is
V_E_Mail S_Emp.E_Mail%Type;
Select E_Mail Into V_E_Mail
From S_Emp
Where Emp_No = P_Emp_No And Rownum<=1;
Return(V_E_Mail);
Return(Null);
-- Consider Logging The Error And Then Re-Raise
Raise;
End Get_Emp_Email;
CREATE OR REPLACE Function Hrs_Get_Instlmnt_Paid ( P_Doc_No_Ref In Number
,P_Doc_Srl_Ref In Number
,P_Instlmnt_No In Number
,P_Chk_Crnt_Prd_Clc In Number Default 0) Return Number
V_Sum Number:=0;
IF P_Chk_Crnt_Prd_Clc = 0 Then
Select Sum(DOC_AMT) Into V_Sum
From hrs_emp_movmnt
where Doc_No_Ref = P_Doc_No_Ref
And Doc_Srl_Ref = P_Doc_Srl_Ref
And Instlmnt_No = P_Instlmnt_No;
Return(NVL(V_Sum,0));
Return(0);
From hrs_emp_movmnt M
And Instlmnt_No = P_Instlmnt_No
And ( Doc_Typ != 775 OR
Prd_no_hrs != HRS_SLRY_CALC_PKG.Get_Actv_Prd(YR_NO_HRS , BRN_NO) OR
Exists(Select 1 From HRS_PRD_BRN_CLS
Where Prd_No = M.PRD_NO_HRS
And YR_NO = M.YR_NO_HRS
And Brn_No = M.BRN_NO
And NVl(SLRY_CALC,0) = 1
And RowNum <= 1));
End Hrs_Get_Instlmnt_Paid;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION GET_INSRNCE_EMP_CNT(P_YR_NO_HRS NUMBER ,
P_PRD_NO_HRS NUMBER ,
P_ARTCL_NO NUMBER ,
P_IN_OUT NUMBER
) RETURN NUMBER
V_PRV_PRD_NO_HRS NUMBER;
V_EMP_CNT NUMBER;
IF P_Prd_No_HRS - 1 < 1 Then
Select NVL(Max(PRD_NO_HRS),0) INTO V_PRV_PRD_NO_HRS
From HRS_V_SLRY_CALC_DTL
Where YR_NO_HRS = P_YR_NO_HRS - 1
AND ROWNUM<=1;
IF V_PRV_PRD_NO_HRS =0 THEN
V_PRV_PRD_NO_HRS:=P_PRD_NO_HRS;
EXCEPTION
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
WHEN OTHERS THEN
END;
V_PRV_PRD_NO_HRS:=P_PRD_NO_HRS-1;
End IF;
IF P_IN_OUT =1 THEN -- IN INSSURANCE
SELECT COUNT(M.EMP_NO)EMP_IN_CNT INTO V_EMP_CNT
FROM HRS_V_SLRY_CALC_DTL M,HRS_ARTCL A
WHERE
A.ARTCL_NO =M.ARTCL_NO
AND M.ARTCL_NO =P_ARTCL_NO
AND M.YR_NO_HRS =P_YR_NO_HRS
AND M.PRD_NO_HRS=P_PRD_NO_HRS
AND M.EMP_NO NOT IN (SELECT D.EMP_NO
FROM HRS_V_SLRY_CALC_DTL D,
HRS_ARTCL A
A.ARTCL_NO = D.ARTCL_NO
AND D.YR_NO_HRS = P_YR_NO_HRS
AND D.PRD_NO_HRS = V_PRV_PRD_NO_HRS
AND D.ARTCL_NO = P_ARTCL_NO
V_EMP_CNT:=0;
ELSIF P_IN_OUT =2 THEN-- OUT OF INSSURANCE
AND M.PRD_NO_HRS=V_PRV_PRD_NO_HRS
AND D.PRD_NO_HRS = P_PRD_NO_HRS
RETURN V_EMP_CNT;
END GET_INSRNCE_EMP_CNT;

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER HRS_EMP_MOVMNT_DEL_TRG
BEFORE DELETE
ON HRS_EMP_MOVMNT REFERENCING NEW AS NEW OLD AS OLD
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
TmpVar NUMBER;
IF :OLD.HLDY_NO IS NOT NULL THEN
IF HRS_GNR_PKG.Get_Rnwl_Flg(P_HLDY_NO =>:OLD.HLDY_NO ) >0 THEN
if (:OLD.Doc_Typ = 713 ) Or (:OLD.Doc_Typ =714 and :OLD.IN_OUT = -1 ) then
Update S_EMP_HLDY_BLNC
Set HLDY_BLNC = NVL(HLDY_BLNC,0) + NVL(:OLD.DUR_DAY,0)
WHERE EMP_NO =:old.EMP_NO
AND HLDY_NO =:OLD.HLDY_NO;
Elsif :OLD.Doc_Typ In (714,705) and :OLD.IN_OUT = 0 AND NVL(:OLD.EFFCT_HLDY_BLNC,1)=1 then
Set HLDY_BLNC = NVL(HLDY_BLNC,0) - NVL(:OLD.DUR_DAY,0)
ElsIf (:OLD.Doc_Typ = 711 and :OLD.HLDY_NO is not null ) then
WHERE EMP_NO =:OLD.EMP_NO
End if;
Raise_Application_Error(-10001,'Error IN Delete Trg When Update S_EMP_HLDY_BLNC = '||Sqlerrm);
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER HRS_EMP_MOVMNT_INSRT_TRG
AFTER INSERT
Declare
Tmpvar Number;
IF :NEW.HLDY_NO IS NOT NULL THEN
IF HRS_GNR_PKG.Get_Rnwl_Flg(P_HLDY_NO =>:NEW.HLDY_NO ) >0 THEN
If (:New.Doc_Typ = 713 ) Or (:New.Doc_Typ =714 And :New.In_Out = -1 ) Then
Update S_Emp_Hldy_Blnc
Set Hldy_Blnc = Nvl(Hldy_Blnc,0) - Nvl(:New.Dur_Day,0)
Where Emp_No =:New.Emp_No
And Hldy_No =:New.Hldy_No;
Elsif :New.Doc_Typ In (714,705) And :New.In_Out = 0 AND NVL(:NEW.EFFCT_HLDY_BLNC,1)=1 Then
Set Hldy_Blnc = Nvl(Hldy_Blnc,0) + Nvl(:New.Dur_Day,0)
ElsIf (:New.Doc_Typ = 711 and :new.HLDY_NO is not null ) then
n Others Then
Raise_Application_Error(-10001,'Error When Update S_Emp_Hldy_Blnc = '||Sqlerrm) ;
End;

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY Hrs_Year_Pkg AS
Function Get_Fld_Tbl_Fnc (P_Tbl_Nm In Varchar2, P_Owner In Varchar2 ) Return Varchar2 Is
Cursor C_Fld Is Select Column_Name From All_Tab_Columns
Where Table_Name = Upper(P_Tbl_Nm)
And Column_Name Not In (Upper('ROW_ID'),Upper('UMARKER'))
And Owner = Upper(P_Owner)
Order By Column_Name;
V_Fld Varchar2(20000);
For I In C_Fld Loop
V_Fld := V_Fld||I.Column_Name||',';
End Loop;
V_Fld:=Substr(V_Fld,1,Length(V_Fld)-1);
Return(V_Fld);
Exception When Others Then
End Get_Fld_Tbl_Fnc;
PROCEDURE Create_View_Multi_Year_Prc Is
Cursor C_Usr Is Select Username From All_Users
Where Username Like 'IAS%'
And Substr(Username,8)=Substr(User,8)
Order By Username Asc;
Cursor C_Tbl_Nm Is Select Tbl_Name , Vw_Name
From ( Select 'HRS_MDCL_CARE_MST' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_MDCL_CARE_MST' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_MDCL_CARE_DTL' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_MDCL_CARE_DTL' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_LOAN_MST' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_LOAN_MST' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_LOAN_DTL' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_LOAN_DTL' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_HLDY_MST' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_HLDY_MST' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_HLDY_DTL' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_HLDY_DTL' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_DSRV_MST' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_DSRV_MST' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_DSRV_DTL' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_DSRV_DTL' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_TCKT_PYMNT' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_TCKT_PYMNT' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_RQ_HLDY' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_RQ_HLDY' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_RQ_HLDY_DTL' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_RQ_HLDY_DTL' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_HLDY_ADJST' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_HLDY_ADJST' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_EMP_MOVMNT' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_EMP_MOVMNT_YR' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_SLRY_CALC_MST_HSTRY' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_SLRY_CALC_MST' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_SLRY_CALC_DTL_HSTRY' Tbl_Name ,'HRS_V_SLRY_CALC_DTL' Vw_Name From Dual
Select 'HRS_MCHN_DATA_ATTNDNC_HSTRY' Tbl_Name ,'FNG_V_MCHN_DATA_ATTNDNC' Vw_Name From Dual --HRS_MCHN_DATA_ATTNDNC_HSTRY
V_All_Fld Varchar2(20000) ;
V_All_Fld2 Varchar2(20000) ;
V_SqlStr Varchar2(20000) ;
V_SqlStr1 Varchar2(20000);
V_SqlStr2 Varchar2(20000);
V_Frst_Usr Number := 0;
Cnt Number := 0;
Cnt2 Number := 0;
Shlv Number;
For I In C_Tbl_Nm Loop
V_All_Fld := Get_Fld_Tbl_Fnc (P_Tbl_Nm => I.Tbl_Name, P_Owner => User) ;
V_SqlStr := 'Create Or Replace Force VIEW '||I.Vw_Name||' AS ' ;
V_SqlStr1 := ' ' ;
V_Frst_Usr:= 0 ;
Select Count(Column_Name) Into Cnt From User_Tab_Columns
Where Table_Name = Upper(I.Tbl_Name)
And Column_Name Not In (Upper('ROW_ID'),Upper('UMARKER'));
Cnt := 0;
For I_Usr In C_Usr Loop
V_All_Fld2 := Get_Fld_Tbl_Fnc (P_Tbl_Nm => I.Tbl_Name, P_Owner => I_Usr.Username) ;
IF V_All_Fld = V_All_Fld2 Then
IF I.Vw_Name In ('HRS_V_SLRY_CALC_MST') Then
V_SqlStr1 := V_SqlStr1 || ' SELECT ROWID ROW_ID, 1 UMARKER , 1 HSTRY_FLG, '||V_All_Fld||' FROM '||I_Usr.Username||'.'||I.Tbl_Name ;
V_SqlStr1 := V_SqlStr1 || ' SELECT ROWID ROW_ID, 1 UMARKER , '||V_All_Fld||' FROM '||I_Usr.Username||'.'||I.Tbl_Name ;
If I.Vw_Name In ('HRS_V_LOAN_MST','HRS_V_LOAN_DTL','HRS_V_HLDY_MST') Then
V_SqlStr1 := V_SqlStr1 ||' Where Nvl(TRNSFR_YR_TYP,0) <> 2 ';
V_SqlStr1 := V_SqlStr1 ||' UNION ALL '||Chr(13) ;
V_Frst_Usr := 1 ;
If I.Vw_Name In ('HRS_V_SLRY_CALC_MST') Then
V_SqlStr1 := V_SqlStr1 ||' SELECT ROWID ROW_ID, 1 UMARKER , 0 HSTRY_FLG, '||V_All_Fld||' FROM HRS_SLRY_CALC_MST ' ;
ElsIF I.Vw_Name In ('HRS_V_SLRY_CALC_DTL') Then
V_SqlStr1 := V_SqlStr1 ||' SELECT ROWID ROW_ID, 1 UMARKER , '||V_All_Fld||' FROM HRS_SLRY_CALC_DTL ' ;
ElsIF I.Vw_Name In ('FNG_V_MCHN_DATA_ATTNDNC') Then
V_SqlStr1 := V_SqlStr1 ||' SELECT ROWID ROW_ID, 1 UMARKER , '||V_All_Fld||' FROM HRS_MCHN_DATA_ATTNDNC ' ;
V_SqlStr2 := ' SELECT ROWID ROW_ID,2 UMARKER , 1 HSTRY_FLG, '||V_All_Fld||' FROM '||I.Tbl_Name||' WHERE 1 = 2 ' ;
V_SqlStr2 := ' SELECT ROWID ROW_ID,2 UMARKER , '||V_All_Fld||' FROM '||I.Tbl_Name||' WHERE 1 = 2 ' ;
Execute immediate(V_SqlStr||V_SqlStr1||V_SqlStr2) ;
Exception when others then
If Ias_Dbs_Sys_Pkg.Check_Object ( Upper(I.Vw_Name) , 'VIEW') = 0 Then
Execute immediate(V_SqlStr||' SELECT '||V_All_Fld||' FROM '||I.Tbl_Name);
End If ;
End Loop ;
--##------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
End Create_View_Multi_Year_Prc;
P_BRN_YEAR IN Number ) Return Varchar2 IS

P_Usr_No In Pls_Integer) Is
G_Lng_No:=P_Lng_no;
G_Usr_No:=P_Usr_No;
Select Cur_Code Into G_loc_cur_code from Ex_Rate Where L_F=1;
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20420,'Error When select Local Cur. from Ex_Rate , '||SQLERRM);
Select nvl(Use_Audit_Doc ,0) Into G_Use_Audit_Doc From Ias_Para_Gen;

RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20420,'Error When select Gnr_Prmtr , '||SQLERRM);
End Get_Prmtr_Prc;
FUNCTION Chk_Exist_Doc_Fnc ( P_Doc_Typ In IAS_POST_MST.DOC_TYPE%TYPE , P_Doc_Srl In IAS_POST_MST.DOC_SER%TYPE) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_cnt NUMBER:=0;
Select 1
Into V_cnt
From IAS_POST_MST
Where DOC_TYPE = P_Doc_Typ
And DOC_SER = P_Doc_Srl
And RowNum<=1;
RETURN (V_cnt);
RETURN (0);
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR (-20442,'Error When Select IAS_POST_MST '||SqlErrm);
END Chk_Exist_Doc_Fnc;
PROCEDURE Del_Doc_Prc ( P_Doc_Typ In IAS_POST_MST.DOC_TYPE%TYPE , P_Doc_Srl In IAS_POST_MST.DOC_SER%TYPE) IS
DELETE FROM IAS_POST_DTL
WHERE DOC_TYPE = P_Doc_Typ
AND DOC_SER = P_Doc_Srl;
DELETE FROM IAS_POST_MST
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR (-20443,'Error When Delete IAS_POST_MST '||SqlErrm);
END Del_Doc_Prc;
P_Lng_no In Pls_Integer) Is
IAS_POSTING_PKG.GET_PARA(P_LANG_NO => P_Lng_no, P_USER_NO=> P_Usr_No);
--.Get_Prmtr_Prc (P_Lng_no=>P_Lng_no , P_Usr_No=>P_Usr_No);
If Chk_Exist_Doc_Fnc ( P_Doc_Typ => P_Doc_Typ , P_Doc_Srl=> P_Doc_Srl ) > 0 Then
Del_Doc_Prc ( P_Doc_Typ => P_Doc_Typ , P_Doc_Srl=> P_Doc_Srl ) ;
Get_Prmtr_Prc (P_Lng_no=>P_Lng_no , P_Usr_No=>P_Usr_No);
If P_Doc_Typ = 717 Then -- Clear Trust
Pst_Paymnt_Trust_Prc (P_Pst_Typ =>0,P_Doc_Srl=>P_Doc_Srl);
ElsIf P_Doc_Typ = 775 Then -- calc Salary
Pst_Slry_Calc_Prc (P_Pst_Typ =>0,P_Doc_Srl=>P_Doc_Srl);
ElsIf P_Doc_Typ = 805 Then -- Medical Salary
Pst_Mdcl_Care_Prc (P_Pst_Typ =>0,P_Doc_Srl=>P_Doc_Srl);
ElsIf P_Doc_Typ = 736 Then -- Deserve Employee
Pst_Dsrv_Prc (P_Pst_Typ =>0,P_Doc_Srl=>P_Doc_Srl);
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20420,'Error When Insert Doc. Into Posting Tables , '||SQLERRM);
END Insrt_Doc_In_Pst_Prc;

For M_cv In

,Mst.Doc_jv_typ_ref Doc_jv_typ_ref
,0 Extrnl_Pst
,Mst.cur_code cur_code
,Mst.cur_rate cur_rate
,Mst.UNPOST_U_ID UNPOST_U_ID

,Mst.Brn_Usr Brn_Usr
,Mst.Yr_no_Hrs Yr_no

,Mst.Audit_Ref_Desc
,Mst.Audit_Ref_U_Id
,Mst.Audit_Ref_Date
From HRS_PYMNT_FIN_TRUST_MST Mst
Where nvl(Mst.Doc_Post,0)= Decode(Nvl(P_Pst_Typ,0),0,0,nvl(Mst.Doc_Post,0))
and Mst.doc_no between nvl(P_f_doc_no,Mst.doc_no) and nvl(P_t_doc_no,Mst.doc_no)
and Mst.doc_date between nvl(P_f_doc_date,Mst.doc_date) and nvl(P_t_doc_date,Mst.doc_date)
and Mst.doc_srl = nvl(P_doc_srl, Mst.doc_srl)
and Mst.Brn_No = nvl(P_Brn_No,Mst.Brn_No)
and Exists (Select 1 from S_BRN_USR_PRIV Prv
Where Prv.U_Id = G_Usr_No
and Prv.Brn_No = Mst.Brn_No
and Prv.Add_Flag = 1
and RowNum<=1)
For Update NoWait)
Loop --(1)
IF Chk_Exist_Doc_Fnc (P_DOC_TYP => M_cv.Doc_Typ, P_DOC_SRL => M_cv.Doc_Srl ) = 0 THEN -- (2)
--##----------------------------------------------------------------##--

,(nvl(Dtl.DOC_AMT,0) * nvl(M_cv.cur_rate,1)) amt_l
,Decode(M_cv.cur_code,G_loc_cur_Code,0,nvl(Dtl.DOC_AMT,0)) amt_f

PROCEDURE MRG_FNL_SLRY_WTH_RPRT(P_EMP_NO NUMBER DEFAULT NULL ,P_PRD_NO NUMBER ,P_YR_NO NUMBER ,P_RPRT_NO number) is
--##--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
V_DOC_NO NUMBER(30);
V_DOC_SRL NUMBER(30);
V_DOC_DATE DATE;
V_DOC_DSC VARCHAR2(500);
V_BRN_YEAR NUMBER(4);
V_BRN_USR NUMBER(3);
V_CMP_NO NUMBER(3);
SELECT DISTINCT DOC_NO,DOC_SRL,DOC_DATE,DOC_DSC ,BRN_YEAR ,BRN_USR,CMP_NO
INTO V_DOC_NO,V_DOC_SRL,V_DOC_DATE,V_DOC_DSC ,V_BRN_YEAR ,V_BRN_USR,V_CMP_NO
WHERE YR_NO_HRS = P_YR_NO
AND PRD_NO_HRS = P_PRD_NO
AND EMP_NO = P_EMP_NO;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
--->
MERGE INTO
HRS_SLRY_CALC_DTL D
USING (SELE
CT DISTINCT G.EMP_NO, D.PRD_NO_HRS, D.ARTCL_NO, D.YR_NO_HRS,D.AD_U_ID,D.AD_DATE ,RPRT_NO,
G.BRN_NO ,
G.HRCHY_NO, G.GRD_NO, G.EMP_JOB_NO, G.SLRY_ST, G.EMP_CRNT_ST, G.EMPLYMNT_TYP, G.CLASS_NO, G.CTGRY_NO, G.LVL_NO ,
G.CUR_CODE
FROM HRS_STMNT_RPRT_DES_DTL D,S_EMP G , HRS_SLRY_CALC_DTL S
WHERE D.YR_NO_HRS = S.YR_NO_HRS
AND D.PRD_NO_HRS = S.PRD_NO_HRS
AND S.EMP_NO = G.EMP_NO
AND G.EMP_NO = P_EMP_NO
AND D.PRD_NO_HRS = P_PRD_NO
AND D.YR_NO_HRS = P_YR_NO
AND D.RPRT_NO = P_RPRT_NO
AND (NVL(G.EMP_CRNT_ST,0)=1 or NVL(G.EMP_CRNT_ST,0)=4)
AND D.RPRT_TYP=1
ON ( d.PRD_NO_HRS = o.PRD_NO_HRS
and d.ARTCL_NO = o.ARTCL_NO
And d.YR_NO_HRS = o.YR_NO_HRS
AND d.EMP_NO = o.EMP_NO
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT (D.EMP_NO,
D.ARTCL_NO,
D.YR_NO_HRS,
D.PRD_NO_HRS,
D.AMT ,
D.CUR_CODE,
D.CUR_RATE,
D.DOC_NO ,
D.DOC_SRL ,
D.DOC_DATE,
D.DOC_DSC ,
D.ARTCL_TYP ,
D.HRCHY_NO, D.GRD_NO, D.EMP_JOB_NO, D.SLRY_ST, D.EMP_CRNT_ST, D.EMPLYMNT_TYP, D.CLASS_NO, D.CTGRY_NO, D.LVL_NO,
BRN_YEAR ,BRN_USR,CMP_NO
VALUES (O.EMP_NO,
O.ARTCL_NO,
O.YR_NO_HRS,
O.PRD_NO_HRS ,
O.CUR_CODE ,
Ys_Gen_Pkg.Get_Cur_Rate (P_cur_code=>O.CUR_CODE ,P_Rate_Type=>0,P_Date=>V_DOC_DATE ),
O.BRN_NO ,
V_DOC_NO ,
V_DOC_SRL ,
V_DOC_DATE,
V_DOC_DSC ,
HRS_ARTCL_PKG.Get_Artcl_Typ(P_ARTCL_NO=>O.ARTCL_NO) ,
O.AD_U_ID,
O.AD_DATE,
O.HRCHY_NO, O.GRD_NO, O.EMP_JOB_NO, O.SLRY_ST, O.EMP_CRNT_ST, O.EMPLYMNT_TYP, O.CLASS_NO, O.CTGRY_NO, O.LVL_NO,
V_BRN_YEAR ,V_BRN_USR,V_CMP_NO
COMMIT;
ROLLBACK;
--RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR (-20009,'Error When Merg Proc Err='||SqlErrm);
end MRG_FNL_SLRY_WTH_RPRT;
PROCEDURE MRG_FNL_SLRY_HSTRY_WTH_RPRT(P_EMP_NO NUMBER DEFAULT NULL ,P_PRD_NO NUMBER ,P_YR_NO NUMBER ,P_RPRT_NO number) is
HRS_SLRY_CALC_DTL_HSTRY D
USING (SELECT DISTINCT G.EMP_NO, D.PRD_NO_HRS, D.ARTCL_NO, D.YR_NO_HRS,D.AD_U_ID,D.AD_DATE ,RPRT_NO,
FROM HRS_STMNT_RPRT_DES_DTL D,S_EMP G , HRS_SLRY_CALC_DTL_HSTRY S
end MRG_FNL_SLRY_HSTRY_WTH_RPRT;
PROCEDURE MRG_FNL_SLRY_STP_WTH_RPRT(P_EMP_NO NUMBER DEFAULT NULL ,P_PRD_NO NUMBER ,P_YR_NO NUMBER ,P_RPRT_NO number) is
FROM HRS_SLRY_STP_DTL
HRS_SLRY_STP_DTL D
G.HRCHY_NO, G.GRD_NO, G.EMP_JOB_NO, G.SLRY_ST, G.EMP_CRNT_ST, G.EMPLYMNT_TYP, G.CLASS_NO, G.CTGRY_NO, G.LVL_NO
FROM HRS_STMNT_RPRT_DES_DTL D,S_EMP G , HRS_SLRY_STP_DTL S
End MRG_FNL_SLRY_STP_WTH_RPRT;
P_LNG_NO IN NUMBER DEFAULT 1) RETURN varchar2 Is
V_FLD_TXT Varchar2(200);
V_TXT_BFR Varchar2(4000);
V_TXT Varchar2(4000);
V_TXT_CNT Number;
V_FRST_OCC Number;
V_LAST_OCC Number;
V_FLD_TYP Number;
V_FLD_NO Number;
V_TXT_CNT := LENGTH(P_TXT);
V_FRST_OCC := INSTR(P_TXT,'[[',1,1);
V_LAST_OCC := INSTR(P_TXT,']]',1,1);
IF V_FRST_OCC >0 THEN
V_TXT_BFR := SUBSTR(P_TXT,1,V_FRST_OCC-1);
V_TXT := SUBSTR(P_TXT,V_LAST_OCC+2);
V_FLD_TXT := SUBSTR(P_TXT,V_FRST_OCC+2,(V_LAST_OCC-V_FRST_OCC-1));
V_FLD_TYP := SUBSTR(V_FLD_TXT,1,INSTR(V_FLD_TXT,'-')-1);
V_FLD_NO := LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTR( V_FLD_TXT,INSTR( V_FLD_TXT,'-')+1,(INSTR( V_FLD_TXT,'=>')-INSTR( V_FLD_TXT,'-') -1 ) )));
IF V_FLD_TYP = 2 AND V_FLD_NO IS NOT NULL THEN
V_FLD_TXT := HRS_SLRY_RPRT_PKG.GET_VAL_FIELD ( P_FLD_NO => V_FLD_NO,
P_EMP_NO => P_EMP_NO,
P_LNG_NO => P_LNG_NO);
ELSIF V_FLD_TYP = 1 THEN
SELECT SUM(AMT) INTO V_FLD_
FROM HRS_SLRY_CALC_DTL D
WHERE D.ARTCL_NO = V_FLD_NO
AND D.EMP_NO = P_EMP_NO ;
V_TXT:= V_TXT_BFR||V_FLD_TXT||GET_FLD_TXT ( P_TXT => V_TXT, P_EMP_NO => P_EMP_NO);
RETURN(V_TXT);
RETURN (P_TXT);
END GET_FLD_TXT;

INSERT INTO HRS_SLRY_CALC_MST (

Null,

P_PRD_NO_HRS,

V_Prd_No_Gl,
P_Usr_No,
Ys_Gen_Pkg.Get_Curdate,
P_CMP_NO,

P_BRN_USR);

v_f_date Date;

FUNCTION Stp_Extra_No(
P_Emp_No In S_Emp.Emp_No%TYPE,
) RETURN NUMBER IS
AB_SUM NUMBER:=0;
TOT_SUM NUMBER:=0;
V_F_CAL DATE;
V_T_CAL DATE;
x NUMBER:=0;
M_CALC NUMBER:=0;
DY_DEPND NUMBER:=0;
V_VAL NUMBER:=0;
P_Val NUMBER:=0;
N_paid NUMBER:=0;
SELECT NVL(ARTCL_STOP,0)
INTO N_paid
N_paid :=0;
IF N_paid=1 THEN
FOR I IN(SELECT ARTCL_NO,
ARTCL_NO_CALC,
ARTCL_VAL , T_ARTCL_VAL ,
(SELECT ARTCL_FRQNCY FROM HRS_ARTCL WHERE ARTCL_NO=P_ARTCL_NO) Extra_Fixed
FROM HRS_ARTCL_CALC
WHERE ARTCL_NO=P_ARTCL_NO
AND CALC_TYP=2)
LOOP --- SEARCH FROM BADAL THAT WILL BE STOPED
--##---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------##--
IF I.Extra_Fixed =1 THEN --
SELECT Count(1) INTO V_Val
FROM HRS_ARTCL_EMP
WHERE ARTCL_NO=I.ARTCL_NO_CALC AND Emp_No=P_Emp_No;
V_Val :=0;
------------------------------------------------
IF V_Val>0 THEN
SELECT Sum(NVL(ARTCL_VAL,0)) INTO V_Val
ELSIF I.Extra_Fixed=2 THEN --
SELECT Count(1)
INTO V_Val
FROM HRS_ARTCL_MOV_DTL
WHERE ARTCL_NO =I.ARTCL_NO_CALC
AND PRD_NO_HRS=P_PRD_NO_HRS
AND Emp_No =P_Emp_No ;
--HRS_Slry_Calc_Pkg.INSRT_TST(FLD_CHR => 'IN STOP Emp_no->'||P_Emp_no||' Artcl_no->'||p_artcl_no ||'V_Val->'||V_VAL||' F_Val->'||I.ARTCL_VAL||' T_Val->'||I.T_ARTCL_VAL);
IF NVL(I.ARTCL_VAL,0) <= V_Val AND NVL(I.T_ARTCL_VAL,0) >= V_Val THEN ----CHECK FROM VALUE V_STP:=1;
RETURN (1);
END Loop;
When Others THEN
END Stp_Extra_No;
V_Prd_No HRS_PRD_BRN_CLS.Prd_No%Type ;
-- HOW GET THE ACTV PRD
Select Min(Prd_No)
Into V_Prd_No
From HRS_PRD_BRN_CLS
Where YR_NO = P_Brn_Year
And Brn_No = P_Brn_No
And Nvl(Prd_Cls,0) = 0;
Return(V_Prd_No);
END Get_Actv_Prd;
) IS
VAL NUMBER:=0;
X NUMBER:=0;
Y NUMBER:=0;
V_F_CAL DATE:=SYSDATE;
V_T_CAL DATE:=SYSDate;
V_CUR EX_RATE.CUR_CODE%TYPE;
V_Cont NUMBER:=0;
V_Doc_Typ Number;

----##-- Get Basic Cur_Code For Emp

FUNCTION CHK_EMP_FNSH ( P_EMP_NO In NUMBER ,
V_EMP_FNSH NUMBER;
V_SLR_ST NUMBER;
V_Cnt
NUMBER;
V_END_D DATE;

V_T_Prd DATE;

INTO V_EMP_FNSH , V_END_D
IF V_END_D IS NULL AND V_EMP_FNSH = 1 THEN
IF P_PRD_NO_HRS IS NOT NULL AND P_Brn_Year IS NOT NULL THEN
SELECT F_DATE,T_DATE
INTO V_F_Prd,V_T_Prd
WHERE Prd_No = P_PRD_NO_HRS
AND Yr_No = P_Brn_Year
--And Unt_No = P_Brn_No
----Prl_Slry_Calc_Pkg.INSRT_TST(FLD_CHR => 'G_P_Use_Prd_Day-> '||G_P_Use_Prd_Day||'G_Day_Prd-> '||G_Day_Prd|| ' V_Wrk_DY->'||V_Wrk_DY);
IF V_END_D IS NOT NULL THEN
IF V_END_D <= V_F_Prd THEN
ELSIF V_END_D IS NOT NULL THEN
IF V_F_Prd Is Not Null And V_T_Prd Is Not Null THEN
SELECT 1 Into V_Cnt
And D.F_DATE <= V_F_Prd
And Decode(Nvl(M.TRNSFR_EMP_TO_HLDY,0),1,Nvl((M.STRT_WRK_DATE-1),V_T_Prd),D.T_DATE) >= V_T_Prd
And D.Emp_NO=P_Emp_No
And (NVL(D.DSRV_FLG,0)=1
Or Nvl(D.CUT_FRM_WRKDY_FLG,0)=1)
IF V_Cnt >0 Then
RETURN(0 );
END CHK_EMP_FNSH;

Cursor Tax_Cur Is
Select M.Tax_No , M.Tax_Clc_Mthd, M.Artcl_No
From Hrs_Tax_Cod_Mst M
Where
-- M.Tax_No =D.Tax_No
-- And M.Artcl_No=D.Artcl_No
M.Artcl_No = P_Artcl_No
AND M.Cur_Code =P_Cur_Code
AND NVL(M.INACTIVE,0)=0
V_Tax_Contnt_Val Number ;
V_Tax_Val Number:=0;
V_Tax_Val_All Number:=0;
k Number;
V_Tax_Contnt_Val_TMP NUMBER:=0;
V_Fnsh_Loop Number:=0;
V_Tax_Contnt_Val :=P_Tax_Contnt_Val;
For I In Tax_Cur Loop
For J In ( Select F_Val,T_Val,Tax_Val ,Rcrd_No ,TAX_AMT_TYP From Hrs_Tax_Cod_Dtl Where Tax_No =I.TAX_NO Order By Rcrd_no ) Loop
If I.Tax_Clc_Mthd=1 Then --
IF V_Tax_Contnt_Val > J.T_Val THEN
V_Tax_Contnt_Val_TMP := J.T_Val - J.F_Val ;
ELSIF V_Tax_Contnt_Val <= J.T_Val AND V_Tax_Contnt_Val >= J.F_Val THEN
V_Tax_Contnt_Val_TMP := V_Tax_Contnt_Val - J.F_Val ;
IF V_Tax_Contnt_Val_TMP >0 THEN
If J.TAX_AMT_TYP =2 Then -- Persentage
V_Tax_Val := (V_Tax_Contnt_Val_TMP * Nvl(J.Tax_Val,0)/100);
ElsIf J.TAX_AMT_TYP =1 Then -- Amount
V_Tax_Val := J.Tax_Val;
ElsIf I.Tax_Clc_Mthd=2 Then --
If V_Tax_Contnt_Val <= J.T_Val AND V_Tax_Contnt_Val >= J.F_Val Then
If j.TAX_AMT_TYP =2 Then -- Persentage
V_Tax_Val := (V_Tax_Contnt_Val * Nvl(j.Tax_Val,0)/100);
ElsIf j.TAX_AMT_TYP =1 Then -- Amount
V_Tax_Val :=J.Tax_Val;
V_Fnsh_Loop :=1 ; --23-01-2017
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
If V_Tax_Val >0 then
G_AMT_IN_TAX := G_AMT_IN_TAX + V_Tax_Contnt_Val_TMP;
G_AMT_RLSD_TAX := G_AMT_RLSD_TAX + V_Tax_Contnt_Val_TMP;
V_Tax_Val_All :=V_Tax_Val_All + V_Tax_Val;
V_Tax_Val:=0;
V_Tax_Contnt_Val_TMP:=0;
if V_Fnsh_Loop =1 then --23-01-2017
V_Fnsh_Loop :=0 ;
Exit ;
End loop;
Return(V_Tax_Val_All);
End Get_Tax_Val;

Function CHK_EMP_MOV_SLRY(P_EMP_NO NUMBER
V_F_PRD_DATE DATE ;
V_T_PRD_DATE DATE;
SELECT NVL(PART_SLRY_CC_CODE,0)
INTO G_PRMTR_PARTN_SLRY
G_PRMTR_PARTN_SLRY := 0 ;
IF G_PRMTR_PARTN_SLRY >0 THEN
V_F_PRD_DATE:= Hrs_Gnr_Pkg.Get_Prd_Date_F_T (P_PRD_NO => P_PRD_NO_HRS ,
P_Date_Typ =>1 );
V_T_PRD_DATE:= Hrs_Gnr_Pkg.Get_Prd_Date_F_T (P_PRD_NO => P_PRD_NO_HRS ,
P_Date_Typ =>2);
FROM
HRS_TRNSMSN_EMP_MST M,HRS_TRNSMSN_EMP_DTL D
AND M.DOC_TYP=776
AND M.TRNSMSN_DATE > V_F_PRD_DATE AND M.TRNSMSN_DATE < V_T_PRD_DATE
AND (NEW_CC_CODE IS NOT NULL OR NEW_ACTV_NO IS NOT NULL OR NEW_PJ_NO IS NOT NULL);
RETURN(V_CNT);
END CHK_EMP_MOV_SLRY;
PROC
EDURE DVID_SLR(P_ARTCL_NO NUMBER

P_Date_Typ=>1);

G_DY_MOV_Wrk := V_DUR;

G_PJ_NO :=I.CRNT_ACTV_NO;

IF V_CNT_TMP = V_CNT THEN
V_F_D := V_T_D+1;

V_DUR := (V_T_D - V_F_D )+1;

FUNCTION Get_Cncl_Hldy_Day (
P_HLDY_NO IN HRS_EMP_MOVMNT.HLDY_NO%TYPE,
P_EMP_NO In HRS_EMP_MOVMNT.EMP_NO%TYPE
DEFAULT NULL,
P_T_PRD_DATE IN DATE DEFAULT NULL ,
)Return Number Is
V_T_Date Date;
V_Dur_Day_Cncl Number:=0;
V_Dur_Day Number;
cursor C_Mov Is select F_DATE ,T_DATE ,DUR_DAY
FROM HRS_V_EMP_MOVMNT_YR
WHERE DOC_TYP=705
AND HLDY_NO =P_Hldy_No
--AND NVL(EFFCT_HLDY_BLNC,1) = 0
AND DECODE(NVL(DOC_SQ_REF,0),0,1,DOC_SQ_REF) = DECODE(NVL(DOC_SQ_REF,0),0,1,Nvl(P_Doc_SQ_Hldy,DOC_SQ_REF))
--24-01-2017
AND DOC_SRL_REF IN (DECODE(NVL(P_Doc_Srl_Hldy,0),0,DOC_SRL_REF,P_Doc_Srl_Hldy) ,
DECODE(NVL(P_DOC_SRL_HLDY_Y,0),0,0,P_DOC_SRL_HLDY_Y)) ;
V_Dur_Day_Cncl_Sum number :=0;
/* Begin
SELECT F_DATE ,T_DATE ,DUR_DAY
Into V_F_DATE ,V_T_DATE ,V_Dur_Day
AND DOC_SRL_REF= DECODE(NVL(P_Doc_Srl_Hldy,0),0,DOC_SRL_REF,P_Doc_Srl_Hldy)
V_F_DATE := Null;
V_T_DATE :=Null;
V_Dur_Day:=Null;
V_Dur_Day_Cncl_Sum :=0;
For I In C_Mov Loop
If I.Dur_Day IS Not Null Then
V_Dur_Day_Cncl :=0;
IF P_F_PRD_DATE Is Null And P_T_PRD_DATE IS Null Then
V_Dur_Day_Cncl :=I.Dur_Day;
ElsIF P_F_PRD_DATE Is Not Null And P_T_PRD_DATE IS Not Null Then
--28/12/2016
If I.F_DATE >= P_F_PRD_DATE and I.F_DATE <= P_T_PRD_DATE THEN
if I.T_DATE <= P_T_PRD_DATE Then
Elsif I.T_DATE > P_T_PRD_DATE Then
V_Dur_Day_Cncl :=(P_T_PRD_DATE - I.F_DATE ) +1;
Elsif I.F_DATE <= P_F_PRD_DATE and I.T_DATE <= P_T_PRD_DATE Then
ElsIf P_F_PRD_DATE Is Not Null Then
If I.F_DATE >= P_F_PRD_DATE Then
V_Dur_Day_Cncl :=(I.T_DATE - P_F_PRD_DATE) +1;
ElsIf P_T_PRD_DATE Is Not Null Then
If I.F_DATE <= P_T_PRD_DATE Then
V_Dur_Day_Cncl :=(P_T_PRD_DATE- I.F_DATE ) +1;
V_Dur_Day_Cncl_Sum := V_Dur_Day_Cncl_Sum + V_Dur_Day_Cncl ;
return (V_Dur_Day_Cncl_Sum);
Return (0);
End Get_Cncl_Hldy_Day;

V_PER_VAL NUMBER:=0 ;

FUNCTION Get_Artcl_Nm( P_Artcl_No HRS_ARTCL.Artcl_No%TYPE, P_LNG_NO IN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2
V_Artcl_Nm HRS_ARTCL.Artcl_L_Nm%TYPE;
SELECT DECODE(P_LNG_NO,1,Artcl_L_Nm,nvl(Artcl_F_Nm,Artcl_L_Nm) ) INTO V_Artcl_Nm FROM HRS_ARTCL M
WHERE M.Artcl_No=P_Artcl_No
RETURN V_Artcl_Nm;
RETURN NULL;
END Get_Artcl_Nm;
P_MSG_NO IN OUT Ias_Msgs.Msg_No%Type ) IS
v_prv_scr NUMBER(1):=0;
v_prv_rprt NUMBER(1):=0;
V_inactv_artcl HRS_ARTCL.INACTIVE%TYPE;
V_Sql VARCHAR2(4000);
IF P_Usr_No = 1 Then
V_Sql :=' Select Decode('||P_LANG_NO||',1,M.ARTCL_L_NM,nvl(M.ARTCL_F_NM,M.ARTCL_L_NM)) ,INACTIVE, 1 ADD_FLAG, 1 VIEW_FLAG
From HRS_ARTCL M
Where M.ARTCL_NO = '||P_ARTCL_NO||
' and RowNum<=1 '|| P_WHR ;
Execute Immediate V_Sql INTO P_ARTCL_NM,V_inactv_artcl,v_prv_scr,v_prv_rprt ;--; Using P_Usr_No ,P_ARTCL_NO;*/
V_Sql :=' Select Decode('||P_LANG_NO||',1,M.ARTCL_L_NM,nvl(M.ARTCL_F_NM,M.ARTCL_L_NM)) ,INACTIVE,nvl(D.ADD_FLAG,0),nvl(D.VIEW_FLAG,0)
From HRS_ARTCL M, HRS_V_USR_ARTCL_PRV D
Where M.ARTCL_NO = D.ARTCL_NO
And D.U_ID = '||P_Usr_No||
'and M.ARTCL_NO = '||P_ARTCL_NO||
IF P_scr_typ = 1 and V_inactv_artcl <> 0 THEN
P_Msg_No:=1638; --Inactive Articl
IF P_scr_typ = 1 and v_prv_scr = 0 THEN
P_Msg_No:=1639; --YOU DONT HAVE A PRIVILEGE ON THIS ARTICLE
P_Msg_No:=1640; -- Ar
ticle Is Not Found
END Chk_Artcl;
FUNCTION Get_Artcl_Ac ( P_Artcl_No IN HRS_ARTCL.ARTCL_No%TYPE , P_Emp_No IN S_EMP.EMP_NO%TYPE DEFAULT NULL) RETURN VARCHAR2 Is
V_AC_CODE VARCHAR2(30);
V_SUB_DRCTRY_CODE VARCHAR2(30);
V_CONN_ACCNT_MTHD NUMBER;
SELECT AC_CODE , NVL(CONN_ACCNT_MTHD,1)
INTO V_AC_CODE ,V_CONN_ACCNT_MTHD
IF V_CONN_ACCNT_MTHD = 1 THEN -- BY ARTCL
RETURN (V_AC_CODE);
ELSIF V_CONN_ACCNT_MTHD = 2 AND P_EMP_NO IS NOT NULL THEN -- BY EMPLOYEE
SELECT AC_CODE
INTO V_AC_CODE
FROM HRS_CONN_EMP_ACC
ELSIF V_CONN_ACCNT_MTHD In (4,5,6) AND P_EMP_NO IS NOT NULL THEN -- BY EMPLOYEE
IF V_CONN_ACCNT_MTHD = 4 Then
Select CC_Code
Into V_SUB_DRCTRY_CODE
Where Emp_No = P_EMP_NO And RowNum<=1;
ElsIF V_CONN_ACCNT_MTHD = 5 Then
Select PJ_NO
Else -- 6
Select ACTV_NO
IF V_SUB_DRCTRY_CODE Is Not Null Then
FROM HRS_CONN_SUB_DRCTRY_ACC
AND CONN_TYP = V_CONN_ACCNT_MTHD
AND SUB_DRCTRY_CODE = V_SUB_DRCTRY_CODE
END Get_Artcl_Ac;
FUNCTION Get_Artcl_cst_cntr (
P_Artcl_No IN HRS_ARTCL.ARTCL_No%TYPE,
P_Emp_No IN S_EMP.EMP_NO%TYPE DEFAULT NULL ,
P_HRS_CC_LNK_TYP NUMBER
RETURN VARCHAR2
V_CC_CODE VARCHAR2 (30);
IF P_HRS_CC_LNK_TYP = 1
SELECT CC_CODE
INTO V_CC_CODE
WHERE EMP_NO = P_EMP_NO AND ROWNUM <= 1;
ELSIF P_HRS_CC_LNK_TYP = 2
WHERE ARTCL_NO = P_ARTCL_NO AND ROWNUM <= 1;
ELSIF P_HRS_CC_LNK_TYP = 3
WHERE ARTCL_NO = P_ARTCL_NO AND EMP_NO = P_EMP_NO AND ROWNUM <= 1;
RETURN (V_CC_CODE);
WHEN OTHERS
RETURN (NULL);
END Get_Artcl_cst_cntr;
FUNCTION Get_Artcl_Pj_No (P_Artcl_No IN HRS_ARTCL.ARTCL_No%TYPE,
P_HRS_PJ_LNK_TYP NUMBER)
V_PJ_NO VARCHAR2 (30);
IF P_HRS_PJ_LNK_TYP = 1
SELECT PJ_NO
INTO V_PJ_NO
ELSIF P_HRS_PJ_LNK_TYP = 2
ELSIF P_HRS_PJ_LNK_TYP = 3
RETURN (V_PJ_NO);
ETURN (NULL);
END Get_Artcl_Pj_No;
FUNCTION Get_Artcl_Actv_no (
P_HRS_ACTV_LNK_TYP NUMBER
V_ACTV_NO VARCHAR2 (30);
IF P_HRS_ACTV_LNK_TYP = 1
SELECT ACTV_NO
INTO V_ACTV_NO
ELSIF P_HRS_ACTV_LNK_TYP = 2
ELSIF P_HRS_ACTV_LNK_TYP = 3
RETURN (V_ACTV_NO);
END Get_Artcl_Actv_no;
FUNCTION GET_ARTCL_VAL_TYP(P_ARTCL_NO IN HRS_ARTCL.ARTCL_NO %TYPE) RETURN HRS_ARTCL.ARTCL_VAL_TYP%type
V_ARTCL_VAL_TYP HRS_ARTCL.ARTCL_VAL_TYP%type;
Select ARTCL_VAL_TYP
Into V_ARTCL_VAL_TYP
Where ARTCL_NO=P_ARTCL_NO;
RETURN V_ARTCL_VAL_TYP;
End GET_ARTCL_VAL_TYP;
FUNCTION GET_ARTCL_LAW(P_ARTCL_NO IN HRS_ARTCL.ARTCL_NO %TYPE) RETURN HRS_ARTCL.LAW_FLG%type
V_ARTCL_LAW HRS_ARTCL.LAW_FLG%type;
Select LAW_FLG
Into V_ARTCL_LAW
RETURN V_ARTCL_LAW;
When NO_DATA_FOUND Then
RETURN 0;
Raise_application_error(-20089,'Error When GET_ARTCL_LAW '||SqlErrm) ;
End GET_ARTCL_LAW;
FUNCTION GET_ARTCL_CUR_CODE(P_ARTCL_NO IN HRS_ARTCL.ARTCL_NO %TYPE) RETURN HRS_ARTCL.CUR_CODE%type

Select CUR_CODE
Into V_CUR_CODE

ost Due Employee

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE ('SELECT '||V_FLD_NM||' FROM HRS_PARA_AFFRS ') INTO V_DOC_SERIAL;

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE Body Hrs_Gnr_Pkg As
FUNCTION Get_Hrs_Prd_No (P_Doc_Date In Date) Return Number Is
V_prd_no Number;
Select Prd_No
Into V_prd_no
From Hrs_Prd_Dtl
Where P_Doc_Date Between F_Date And T_Date;
Return (V_prd_no);
Return (To_Number (To_Char (P_Doc_Date, 'MM')));
End Get_Hrs_Prd_No ;
FUNCTION Get_Hrs_Prd_Nm (P_Prd_No In Number , P_Lng_no in Number ) Return Varchar2 Is
V_Prd_Nm Hrs_Prd_Dtl.prd_l_nm%Type;
Select Decode(P_Lng_no ,1,Prd_l_nm,nvl(Prd_F_nm,Prd_l_nm))
Into V_prd_Nm
Where Prd_no = P_Prd_no
Return (V_Prd_Nm);
End Get_Hrs_Prd_Nm ;
FUNCTION Get_Frst_Day RETURN DATE Is
v_frst_day Date;
Select Min(F_date)
Into v_frst_day
From HRS_PRD_DTL;
Return(v_frst_day);
Select F_date
From HRS_PRD_DTL
where PRD_NO=1;
End Get_Frst_Day;
FUNCTION Get_Final_Day RETURN DATE Is
v_fnal_day Date;
Select Max(T_date) --to_char(Min(From_date),'DD/MM/YYYY')
Into v_fnal_day
Return(v_fnal_day);
Select T_date
where PRD_NO=( Select max(PRD_NO) From HRS_PRD_DTL );
End Get_Final_Day;
FUNCTION Get_Fng_Frst_Day RETURN DATE Is
v_frst_Fng_Day Date;
Select Min(F_Fng_Date)
Into v_frst_Fng_day

, 3, to_char(P_Date,'DAY','NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE = French')
, 4, to_char(P_Date,'DAY','NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE = Turkish'),P_Date)
INTO V_Day_Nm

End Get_Day_Nm ;

V_MSG_NO := 1736; -- SUM OF permission MINUTES IN THIS DAY ARE MORE THAN ALLOWED ONCE FOR THIS TYPE;

ELSIF P_DOC_TYP= 710 THEN--REQUESTING PERMISSION
AND DOC_SRL <> NVL(P_DOC_SRL,1)
AND NVL(APPROVED,0)<>2; -- NOT A REFUSED PERMISSION;
-- AND PRD_NO_HRS = V_PRD_NO_HRS
AND PRMSN_DATE BETWEEN Get_FRST_Day_BY_PRD(P_PRD_NO=>V_PRD_NO_HRS,P_PRL_FNG_FLG=>2) AND Get_LAST_Day_BY_PRD(P_PRD_NO=>V_PRD_NO_HRS,P_PRL_FNG_FLG=>2)
AND NVL(APPROVED,0)<>2; -- NOT A REFUSED PERMISSION
IF V_MSG_NO IS NOT NULL THEN
END Chk_PRMSN_VLD;
P_F_Time HRS_V_PRD_WRK_EMP.F_Time%Type,
) Return Number

FUNCTION Hrs_Chk_Date( P_Doc_Date In Date,

IF P_Chk_Fng_Calc =1 THEN
--##----------------------------------------------------------

For I In Prd_Cv Loop

V_Msg_No := 1925;-

Return(9);

SELECT 1 INTO V_CNT FROM HRS_PRD_DTL WHERE P_DOC_DATE BETWEEN F_DATE AND T_DATE AND ROWNUM<=1;
Cursor Prd_Cv Is Select nvl(INACTIVE,0) INACTIVE, nvl(PRD_CLS,0) PRD_CLS ,nvl(SLRY_CALC,0) SLRY_CALC

and Brn_No = P_Brn_No

FUNCTION GET_PRD_EMP_BT_DATE( F_DATE DATE, T_DATE DATE, P_EMP_NO IN S_EMP.EMP_NO%TYPE, P_BRN_NO NUMBER DEFAULT NULL) Return Number Is
V_DAY NUMBER:=0;
SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_DAY FROM HRS_PRD_DAY M
WHERE PRD_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(F_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') AND TO_DATE(T_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM HRS_PRD_DAY_HLDY D
WHERE PRD_DATE = M.PRD_DATE
AND ( NVL(D.BRN_NO,0) = DECODE(P_BRN_NO,NULL,NVL(D.BRN_NO,0),P_BRN_NO) OR BRN_NO Is Null)
AND ROWNUM<=1)
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM HRS_PRD_WRK_EMP D , HRS_PRD_WRK_DFN_DTL C
WHERE D.WPRD_NO = C.WPRD_NO
AND C.DAY_NO = Decode(to_char(M.PRD_DATE ,'D') + 1,8,1,to_char(M.PRD_DATE,'D') + 1)
AND C.Day_St = 1
AND ROWNUM<=1) ;
RETURN (V_DAY);
SELECT (TO_DATE(T_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') - TO_DATE(F_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY'))+1 INTO V_DAY FROM DUAL;
END GET_PRD_EMP_BT_DATE;

WHERE PRD_DATE = P_DATE
AND (NVL(BRN_NO,0) = DECODE(P_BRN_NO,NULL,NVL(BRN_NO,0),P_BRN_NO) OR BRN_NO Is Null)
END CHK_DATE_IS_HLDY;

P_EMP_NO IN S_EMP.EMP_NO%TYPE) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_ACTL_BLNC NUMBER;
SELECT NVL(SUM(DUR_TIME),0) INTO V_ACTL_BLNC
WHERE PRD_NO_HRS=P_PRMSN_PRD
RETURN V_ACTL_BLNC;
END Get_Prmsn_Rq_Blnc;
P_ERRMSG OUT VARCHAR2)
V_ERR_MSG VARCHAR2(4000);
SELECT DCSN_SURC,DOC_DATE
INTO P_DCSN_SURC_NO, P_DCSN_DATE
FROM HRS_DCSN_MST
WHERE DOC_NO=P_DOC_NO;
V_ERR_MSG:= SqlErrm;
END GET_DCSN_DATA;

PROCEDURE Get_Hrs_Crnt_Prd_YR (P_BRN_NO IN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE ,P_PRD_NO IN OUT NUMBER , P_YR_NO IN OUT NUMBER) Is

AND BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO;
P_PRD_NO := To_Number (To_Char (Sysdate, 'MM'));
P_YR_NO := To_Number (To_Char (Sysdate, 'YYYY'));
End Get_Hrs_Crnt_Prd_YR;

PROCEDURE Get_EMP_ARTCL_LAW (P_Emp_No S_EMP.EMP_NO%TYPE,
P_RCRD_NO OUT NUMBER
--V_RCRD_NO NUMBER ;
--V_LAW_NO NUMBER ;
-- V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000):='1';
CURSOR ARTCL_LAW_CUR
is(SELECT D.LAW_NO , D.RCRD_NO ,M.NO_OF_CND,
M.LAW_CND1 , D.LAW_CND1_VAL,
M.LAW_CND2 , D.LAW_CND2_VAL,
M.LAW_CND3 , D.LAW_CND3_VAL,
M.LAW_CND4 , D.LAW_CND4_VAL,

M.LAW_CND6 , D.LAW_CND6_VAL,
M.LAW_CND7 , D.LAW_CND7_VAL,

_LAW_ARTCL_DTL D
WHERE 1=1 AND D.LAW_NO=HRS_LAW_PKG.GET_ACTV_ARTCL_LAW

FOR I IN ARTCL_LAW_CUR LOOP
HRS_LAW_PKG.Chk_Emp_CNDTN(P_EMP_NO => P_EMP_NO , P_COD_NO => I.LAW_CND1 , P_CODE_VAL => I.LAW_CND1_VAL) ||

HRS_LAW_PKG.Chk_Emp_CNDTN(P_EMP_NO => P_EMP_NO , P_COD_NO => I.LAW_CND3 , P_CODE_VAL => I.LAW_CND3_VAL) ||
HRS_LAW_PKG.Chk_Emp_CNDTN(P_EMP_NO => P_EMP_NO , P_COD_NO => I.LAW_CND4 , P_CODE_VAL => I.LAW_CND4_VAL) ||
HRS_LAW_PKG.Chk_Emp_CNDTN(P_EMP_NO => P_EMP_NO , P_COD_NO => I.LAW_CND5 , P_CODE_VAL => I.LAW_CND5_VAL) ||

HRS_LAW_PKG.Chk_Emp_CNDTN(P_EMP_NO => P_EMP_NO , P_COD_NO => I.LAW_CND7 , P_CODE_VAL => I.LAW_CND7_VAL) ||
HRS_LAW_PKG.Chk_Emp_CNDTN(P_EMP_NO => P_EMP_NO , P_COD_NO => I.LAW_CND8 , P_CODE_VAL => I.LAW_CND8_VAL) ||
HRS_LAW_PKG.Chk_Emp_CNDTN(P_EMP_NO => P_EMP_NO , P_COD_NO => I.LAW_CND9 , P_CODE_VAL => I.LAW_CND9_VAL) ||
HRS_LAW_PKG.Chk_Emp_CNDTN(P_EMP_NO => P_EMP_NO , P_COD_NO => I.LAW_CND10, P_CODE_VAL => I.LAW_CND10_VAL)
= SUBSTR ('1111111111',11-I.NO_OF_CND)THEN
P_RCRD_NO:=I.RCRD_NO;
P_LAW_NO :=I.LAW_NO ;
EXIT ;
P_RCRD_NO:=0;
P_LAW_NO :=0;
-- P_MSG:=V_MSG;
--P_MSG:='ERROR '||SqlErrm;
--Raise_application_error(-20062,' Error In Applying Employee Article Law'||chr(13)||SqlErrm) ;

P_USR_ID IN NUMBER ,

FUNCTION GET_HLDY_BLNC (P_EMP_NO IN S_EMP.EMP_NO%TYPE,
P_DOC_DATE IN DATE)
V_RNWL_TYP NUMBER;
V_PRD_WRK_DAYS NUMBER;
V_USE_PRD_DAY NUMBER;
V_HLDY_DSRV NUMBER;
V_HLDY_DSRV_PE
R_ONE_DAY NUMBER;
V_EMP_STRT_WRK_DATE DATE;
V_STRT_DATE DATE;
V_LAST_DATE DATE;
V_HLDY_BLNC S_EMP_HLDY_BLNC.HLDY_BLNC%TYPE;
V_DUR_DAY NUMBER ;
V_Blnc_Opn NUMBER;
V_DUR_DAY_EFFCT NUMBER:=0 ;
V_EMP_WRK_HOUR NUMBER ;
V_HLDY_TYP NUMBER ;
V_HLDY_TRNS_OUT NUMBER;
V_HLDY_TRNS_IN NUMBER;
V_HLDY_BLNC_N NUMBER;
V_DUR_REM_OPN NUMBER;
V_SUM_EFF NUMBER;
SELECT nvl(USE_PRD_DAY ,0)
INTO V_USE_PRD_DAY
FROM HRS_PARA;
RAISE_application_error (
-20063,
' Error In GETTING USE_PRD_DAY PARAMETER '
|| CHR (13)
|| SQLERRM
--##-------------------------------------------------------------------##--
SELECT NVL (RNWL_TYP, 1) , NVL(HLDY_TYP,0)
INTO V_RNWL_TYP , V_HLDY_TYP
WHERE HLDY_NO = P_HLDY_NO;
-20064,
' Error In GETTING RNWL_TYP PARAMETER ' || CHR (13) || SQLERRM);
SELECT STRT_WRK_DATE, NVL(LST_WRK_DATE,P_DOC_DATE)
INTO V_EMP_STRT_WRK_DATE, V_LAST_DATE
WHERE EMP_NO = P_EMP_NO AND ROWNUM<=1;
-20065,
' Error In GETTING STRT_WRK_DATE FIELD FOR EMPLOYEE ' || CHR (13) || SQLERRM);
V_EMP_WRK_HOUR := YS_EMP_PKG.Get_Emp_WRK_HOUR (P_EMP_NO => P_EMP_NO, P_WRK_HOUR_TYP => 1);
' Error In GETTING V_EMP_WRK_HOUR FIELD FOR EMPLOYEE ' || CHR (13) || SQLERRM);
IF V_EMP_STRT_WRK_DATE NOT BETWEEN HRS_GNR_PKG.Get_Frst_Day AND HRS_GNR_PKG.Get_FINAL_Day THEN --NOT NEW EMP
V_STRT_DATE:=HRS_GNR_PKG.Get_Frst_Day;
V_STRT_DATE:=V_EMP_STRT_WRK_DATE;
SELECT DECODE(V_RNWL_TYP
,3,COUNT(PRD_NO)
,2,TRUNC( COUNT(PRD_NO) /2)
,1,1
,NVL (SUM (PRD_WRK_DAY), 0))
INTO V_PRD_WRK_DAYS
FROM Hrs_Prd_Dtl;
IF V_USE_PRD_DAY <> 1 AND V_RNWL_TYP = 4 THEN
V_PRD_WRK_DAYS :=365;
SELECT nvl(OPN_HLDY_BLNC,0) , NVL(HLDY_BLNC_RNWL,0)
Into V_Blnc_Opn ,V_HLDY_BLNC
From S_EMP_HLDY_BLNC
Where EMP_NO = P_EMP_NO
And HLDY_NO = P_HLDY_NO
AND RowNum<=1;
V_Blnc_Opn := 0;
IF V_HLDY_TYP = 1 THEN -- HLDY
ANNUAL
FOR I IN
( SELECT Hldy_No FROM HRS_HLDY_CODE WHERE NVL(EFFCT_BLNC_HLDY_YRLY,0)=1 )
V_SUM_EFF:= HRS_SLRY_CALC_PKG.GET_LEAVE_DAY_N ( P_EMP_No =>P_EMP_NO,
P_F_cal =>TO_DATE(V_STRT_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') ,
P_T_cal =>TO_DATE(V_LAST_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') ,
P_HLDY_NO =>I.Hldy_No ,
P_CUT_FRM_WRKDY => 0,
P_DSRV_FLG =>0
V_DUR_DAY_EFFCT:=V_DUR_DAY_EFFCT+V_SUM_EFF ;
Select nvl(Sum(d.Dur_Day),0) + (Nvl(Sum(d.Dur_Time),0)/NVL(V_EMP_WRK_HOUR ,1) )
Into V_DUR_DAY_EFFCT
From HRS_HLDY_MST M , HRS_HLDY_DTL D
Where M.DOC_SRL = D.DOC_SRL
AND D.Emp_No = P_EMP_NO
AND d.HLDY_NO IN (SELECT Hldy_No FROM HRS_HLDY_CODE WHERE NVL(EFFCT_BLNC_HLDY_YRLY,0)=1 )
AND AND (D.F_DATE >= TO_DATE(V_STRT_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') OR D.T_DATE < T
O_DATE(V_LAST_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY'))
AND NVL(M.TRNSFR_YR_TYP,0)<>1; -- 1 = Transfer From privious Year
V_DUR_DAY_EFFCT := 0;
IF V_HLDY_TYP <> 1 THEN -- HLDY NOT ANNUAL
Select nvl(Sum(d.Dur_Day),0) + (nvl(Sum(d.Dur_Time),0)/NVL(V_EMP_WRK_HOUR ,1) )
Into V_DUR_DAY
And D.Emp_No = P_EMP_NO
And D.Hldy_No = P_HLDY_NO
AND (D.F_DATE >= TO_DATE(V_STRT_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') OR D.T_DATE < TO_DATE(V_LAST_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY'))
--And (TO_DATE(V_STRT_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN M.F_DATE AND M.T_DATE OR TO_DATE(V_LAST_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN M.F_DATE AND M.T_DATE)
V_DUR_DAY:= 0;
Get_hldy_Blnc_Trns(P_Emp_No => P_EMP_NO ,
P_Hldy_No =>P_HLDY_NO,
P_HLDY_BLNC =>V_HLDY_BLNC_N ,
P_HLDY_TRNS_IN =>V_HLDY_TRNS_IN,
P_HLDY_TRNS_OUT =>V_HLDY_TRNS_OUT);
V_DUR_DAY := V_HLDY_TRNS_IN - V_HLDY_TRNS_OUT;
IF V_RNWL_TYP IS NOT NULL THEN
IF V_HLDY_BLNC_N >0 THEN
--IF NVL(V_Blnc_Opn,0) - V_DUR_DAY <= 0 THEN
-- V_DUR_REM_OPN :=0;
-- ELSE
V_DUR_REM_OPN :=NVL(V_Blnc_Opn,0) - V_DUR_DAY;
IF V_RNWL_TYP =4 THEN -- Daily
V_HLDY_DSRV_PER_ONE_DAY := (
( (V_HLDY_BLNC) / V_PRD_WRK_DAYS) *
( (V_LAST_DATE - V_STRT_DATE ) - nvl(V_DUR_DAY_EFFCT ,0) ) )
-- - V_DUR_DAY + NVL(V_Blnc_Opn,0) ;
+ V_DUR_REM_OPN;
ELSIF V_RNWL_TYP =3 THEN -- Monthly
( ( V_HLDY_BLNC / V_PRD_WRK_DAYS ) ) *
(TRUNC( MONTHS_BETWEEN( V_LAST_DATE - nvl(V_DUR_DAY_EFFCT ,0) ,V_STRT_DATE )) )
-- - nvl(V_DUR_DAY,0) + Nvl(V_Blnc_Opn,0)
+ V_DUR_REM_OPN
ELSIF V_RNWL_TYP =2 THEN -- Half year
( ( V_HLDY_BLNC / 2 ) ) *
(TRUNC(TRUNC( MONTHS_BETWEEN( V_LAST_DATE - nvl(V_DUR_DAY_EFFCT ,0) ,V_STRT_DATE ) )/ V_PRD_WRK_DAYS ) )
-- - V_DUR_DAY + Nvl(V_Blnc_Opn,0)
ELSIF V_RNWL_TYP =1 THEN -- Yearly
V_HLDY_DSRV_PER_ONE_DAY := V_HLDY_BLNC + V_DUR_REM_OPN; -- - V_DUR_DAY + NVL(V_Blnc_Opn,0) ;
--V_HLDY_DSRV_PER_ONE_DAY := ( ( ( V_HLDY_BLNC - V_DUR_DAY ) ) *
--TRUNC(TRUNC( MONTHS_BETWEEN( V_LAST_DATE - nvl(V_DUR_DAY_EFFCT ,0) ,V_STRT_DATE ) )/ V_PRD_WRK_DAYS ))+ NVL(V_Blnc_Opn,0) ;
V_HLDY_DSRV_PER_ONE_DAY := 0;
hrs_Slry_Calc_Pkg.INSRT_TST(FLD_CHR => 'V_RNWL_TYP -> '||V_RNWL_TYP||'V_HLDY_BLNC ->'||V_HLDY_BLNC ||' V_DUR_DAY->'||V_DUR_DAY
||' V_PRD_WRK_DAYS->'||V_PRD_WRK_DAYS ||' V_LAST_DATE->'||V_LAST_DATE ||' V_DUR_DAY_EFFCT->'||V_DUR_DAY_EFFCT
||' V_STRT_DATE-> '|| V_STRT_DATE||' V_PRD_WRK_DAYS->'||V_PRD_WRK_DAYS||' V_Blnc_Opn->'||V_Blnc_Opn
||' V_HLDY_DSRV_PER_ONE_DAY->>'||V_HLDY_DSRV_PER_ONE_DAY );
-- V_HLDY_BLNC BALANCE YEAR OF EMPLOYEE
-- V_DUR_DAY DAY LEAVE OF EMPLOYEE IN THE SAME DATE

-- V_STRT_DATE FIRST DAY CALC ( STRTE WORK DATE OR START PERIOED DATE)
-- V_DUR_DAY_Effct DAY LEAVE EFFICT BLNC YEARLY LEAVE ( OPTION FROM CODING LEAVE)
-- V_Blnc_Opn BALNCE COME FROM LAST YEAR
IF V_HLDY_DSRV_PER_ONE_DAY > V_HLDY_BLNC_N THEN
V_HLDY_DSRV_PER_ONE_DAY:=V_HLDY_BLNC_N;
RETURN (V_HLDY_DSRV_PER_ONE_DAY);
END GET_HLDY_BLNC;

AND NVL(M.TRNSFR_YR_TYP,0)<>1;
V_HLY_IN :=0;

P_HLDY_TRNS_IN := 0;
P_HLDY_TRNS_OUT:= 0;
END Get_hldy_Blnc_Trns;

V_F_Date := V_T_Date ;

P_PRMSN_DATE IN DATE) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_DUR_DONE NUMBER;
V_MAX_DAY NUMBER;
V_MAX_PRD NUMBER;
SELECT NVL(SUM(D.DUR_TIME),0) ,SUM(M.MAX_LMT_PRMTN_IN_DAY) , SUM(M.MAX_LMT_PRMTN_IN_PRD)
INTO V_DUR_DONE, V_MAX_DAY , V_MAX_PRD
FROM HRS_PRMSN_CODE M, HRS_PRMSN D
WHERE M.PRMSN_NO = D.PRMSN_NO (+)
AND M.PRMSN_NO = P_PRMSN_NO
AND D.PRMSN_DATE = P_PRMSN_DATE ;
IF V_DUR_DONE >= V_MAX_DAY AND V_MAX_DAY IS NOT NULL THEN
V_DUR := 0;
ELSIF V_DUR_DONE >= V_MAX_PRD AND V_MAX_PRD IS NOT NULL THEN
ELSIF V_MAX_DAY IS NOT NULL THEN
V_DUR := NVL(V_MAX_DAY,0) - NVL(V_DUR_DONE,0) ;
V_DUR := NULL;
RETURN( V_DUR);
END GET_PRMSN_BLNC;
V_DUR_DAY NUMBER;
V_DUR_DAY_DONE NUMBER;
V_DUR_TIME_DAY_DONE NUMBER;
V_DUR_TIME_DONE NUMBER;
V_DUR_DAY_TOT_DONE NUMBER;
V_WRK_HOUR_DAY NUMBER;
SELECT NVL(SUM(M.WRK_HRS_DY),0), NVL(SUM(C.DUR_DAY),0) ,NVL(SUM(C.DUR_TIME),0) , NVL(SUM(D.HLDY_BLNC),0)
INTO V_WRK_HOUR_DAY , V_DUR_DAY_DONE , V_DUR_TIME_DONE , V_HLDY_BLNC
FROM S_EMP M, S_EMP_HLDY_BLNC D, HRS_HLDY_MST C
WHERE M.EMP_NO = D.EMP_NO
AND D.HLDY_NO = C.HLDY_NO (+)
AND D.EMP_NO = P_EMP_NO;
FROM S_EMP M, S_EMP_HLDY_BLNC D, HRS_HLDY_DTL C --SAM
IF NVL(V_DUR_TIME_DONE,0) > 0 AND
NVL(V_WRK_HOUR_DAY,0) > 0 THEN
V_DUR_TIME_DAY_DONE := V_DUR_TIME_DONE / V_WRK_HOUR_DAY;
V_DUR_DAY_TOT_DONE := NVL(V_DUR_DAY_DONE,0) + NVL(V_DUR_TIME_DAY_DONE,0);
IF V_DUR_DAY_TOT_DONE >= V_HLDY_BLNC THEN
ELSIF V_DUR_DAY_TOT_DONE < V_HLDY_BLNC THEN
V_DUR := NVL(V_HLDY_BLNC,0) - NVL(V_DUR_DAY_TOT_DONE,0) ;
RETURN(V_DUR);
P_BRN_NO IN HRS_SLRY_CALC_DTL.BRN_NO%TYPE) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_Cur_Code HRS_SLRY_CALC_DTL.CUR_CODE%TYPE;
V_AMT HRS_SLRY_CALC_DTL.AMT%TYPE;
V_Net_Rate Number;
SELECT Cur_Code,abs(AMT)
INTO V_Cur_Code,V_AMT
WHERE ARTCL_No = P_ARTCL_No
AND YR_NO_HRS = P_YR_NO_HRS
V_Cur_Code := P_Cur_Code;
V_AMT := 0 ;
V_Net_Rate:=HRS_SLRY_CALC_PKG.Ext_Cur_Rate( P_CUR_CODE_FRST => V_Cur_Code,
P_CUR_CODE_SCD => P_Cur_Code,
P_CUR_RATE_SCD => P_CUR_RATE);
RETURN(V_AMT * V_Net_Rate);
END GET_ARTCL_SLRY_CLC_AMT;

Brn_No ) < INSTLMNT_AMT
AND ARTCL_NO = P_ARTCL_NO )
IF I.INSTLMNT_AMT - I.PAID_AMT <= V_AMT THEN
V_REM_AMT := V_AMT - (I.INSTLMNT_AMT - I.PAID_AMT);
HRS_SLRY_CALC_PKG.INSRT_LOAN_EMP_INSTL(P_EMP_NO => P_EMP_NO,
P_ARTCL_NO => I.ARTCL_NO,
P_LOAN_SRL => I.DOC_SRL,
P_INSTLMNT_NO => I.INSTLMNT_NO,
P_AMT => (I.INSTLMNT_AMT - I.PAID_AMT),
P_Brn_Year => P_Brn_Year ,
P_PRD_NO_HRS => P_PRD_NO_HRS,
P_DOC_TYP => P_Doc_Typ,
P_DOC_SRL => P_Doc_Srl,
P_DOC_No => P_Doc_No
V_AMT := V_REM_AMT;
V_AMT_ALL:= V_AMT_ALL + (I.INSTLMNT_AMT - I.PAID_AMT);
END Calc_Loan_Dsrv ;
) Return NUMBER is
WORK_P VARCHAR2(15);
V_DAY_ALL NUMBER:=0;
V_DAY_YR NUMBER:=360;
V_CLC_YR NUMBER;
--##----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GET NO. YEAR BETWEEN F_DATE AND TO_DATE
V_CLC_YR:= YS_GEN_PKG.Get_Fld_Value( P_Tab_Nm => 'HRS_PARA' ,
P_Fld_Nm => 'NVL(CLC_DAY_END_SRV,1)' ,
P_Whr => ' Where RowNum <=1 ');
IF V_CLC_YR =1 THEN
V_DAY_YR := P_DY_YR;
TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(TO_DATE(P_T_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY')-
TO_DATE(P_F_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY')+1)/V_DAY_YR)
INTO P_YR
SELECT TRUNC((TO_NUMBER(TO_DATE(P_T_DATE,'dd/mm/yyyy')-
TO_DATE(P_F_DATE,'dd/mm/yyyy')+1
)-P_YR*V_DAY_YR
)/ 30
) INTO P_MNTH
TO_NUMBER(TO_DATE(P_T_DATE,'dd/mm/yyyy')-
)-(P_YR*V_DAY_YR)-(P_MNTH*30)
) INTO P_DY
SELECT TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN (P_T_DATE,P_F_DATE)/12) Yr_N,
TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN (P_T_DATE,P_F_DATE), 12)) Mnth_N,
CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(P_T_DATE, 'dd') -TO_CHAR(P_F_DATE, 'DD') < 0
(TO_CHAR(P_T_DATE, 'DD')+30 - TO_CHAR(P_F_DATE, 'DD')) +1
Case when LAST_DAY(P_T_DATE) = P_T_DATE and TO_CHAR(P_T_DATE, 'DD')<30
then
( ( TO_CHAR(P_T_DATE, 'DD')+ (30-TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(P_T_DATE), 'DD') ) ) -TO_CHAR(P_F_DATE, 'DD'))+1
(TO_CHAR(P_T_DATE, 'DD') -TO_CHAR(P_F_DATE, 'DD'))+1
End DAY_N
P_YR,P_MNTH,P_DY
TO_DATE(P_F_DATE,'dd/mm/yyyy')+1) INTO V_DAY_ALL
RETURN(V_DAY_ALL);
P_YR:=0;
P_MNTH:=0;
P_DY:=0;
END Get_DY_BT_DATE;

FUNCTION Get_Mdcl_Ac ( P_Mdcl_No IN Hrs_Mdcl_Code.Mdcl_No%TYPE) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
FROM Hrs_Mdcl_Code
WHERE Mdcl_NO = P_Mdcl_NO
IF V_AC_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN
END Get_Mdcl_Ac;
P_Doc_Sq IN Hrs_Mdcl_Care_Dtl.Doc_Sq %TYPE DEFAULT NULL) RETURN Number IS
V_Max_Lmt Number;
V_Cnt_Dpndnt Number;
V_Emp_Amt Hrs_Mdcl_Max_Lmt.Emp_Amt%TYPE;
V_One_Dpn
dnt_Add Hrs_Mdcl_Max_Lmt.One_Dpndnt_Add%TYPE;
V_All_Dpndnt_Add Hrs_Mdcl_Max_Lmt.All_Dpndnt_Add%TYPE;
V_F_DATE Hrs_Mdcl_Max_Lmt.F_DATE%TYPE;
V_T_DATE Hrs_Mdcl_Max_Lmt.T_DATE%TYPE;
V_Cmp_Amt Hrs_Mdcl_Care_Dtl.Cmp_Amt%TYPE;
IF P_MAX_LMT_TYP = 1 Then
SELECT Nvl(Emp_Amt,0) , Nvl(One_Dpndnt_Add,0), Nvl(All_Dpndnt_Add,0), F_DATE , T_DATE
INTO V_Emp_Amt, V_One_Dpndnt_Add, V_All_Dpndnt_Add, V_F_DATE, V_T_DATE
From Hrs_Mdcl_Max_Lmt M
WHERE M.Mdcl_NO=P_Mdcl_NO
AND M.Emp_NO=P_Emp_NO
AND M.Cur_Code=P_Cur_Code
AND Nvl(M.INACTIVE,0) = 0
AND Rownum<=1;
WHERE M.Emp_NO=P_Emp_NO
Return Null;
IF V_One_Dpndnt_Add <> 0 Then
SELECT Count(1) INTO V_Cnt_Dpndnt
From S_EMP_FMLY M
WHERE M.Emp_NO = P_Emp_NO
AND M.MDCL_FLG = 1;
V_Cnt_Dpndnt := 0;
IF V_Cnt_Dpndnt < 0 Then
V_Max_Lmt := V_Emp_Amt + (V_One_Dpndnt_Add * V_Cnt_Dpndnt);
V_Max_Lmt := V_Emp_Amt + V_All_Dpndnt_Add;
SELECT SUM(D.Cmp_Amt) INTO V_Cmp_Amt
From Hrs_Mdcl_Care_Mst M , Hrs_Mdcl_Care_Dtl D
AND D.Mdcl_NO = P_Mdcl_NO
AND D.Emp_NO = P_Emp_NO
AND M.DOC_DATE Between Nvl(P_F_Date,V_F_DATE) AND Nvl(P_T_Date,V_T_DATE)
AND Decode(P_Doc_Sq,Null,0,D.Doc_Sq) < NVL(P_Doc_Sq,1);
RETURN(NVL(V_Max_Lmt,0) - Nvl(V_Cmp_Amt,0));
End Get_Mdcl_Bal_Lmt;

|| P_VLTN_NO
INTO P_VLTN_Nm;
P_MSG_NO:=1924; --VIOLATION NO. is not found
END CHK_VLTN_NO;
FUNCTION GET_VLTN_NM (P_VLTN_NO In HRS_VLTN_CODE.VLTN_NO%TYPE , P_Lng_no in Number DEFAULT 1 ) Return Varchar2 IS
V_VLTN_NM HRS_VLTN_CODE.VLTN_L_NM%Type;
Select Decode(P_Lng_no ,1,VLTN_L_NM,nvl(VLTN_F_NM,VLTN_L_NM))
Into V_VLTN_NM
From HRS_VLTN_CODE
Where VLTN_NO = P_VLTN_NO
Return (V_VLTN_NM);
End Get_VLTN_Nm;
P_CALC_TYP IN HRS_VLTN_CODE.CALC_TYP%TYPE ) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_TMS_CNT HRS_VLTN_LAW.TMS_CNT%Type;
IF P_CALC_TYP =1 THEN -- WHOLE WORK PERIOD
Select COUNT(TMS_CNT)+1 INTO V_TMS_CNT FROM HRS_V_VLTN_DTL
ELSIF P_CALC_TYP =2 THEN -- ANNUALLY
AND YR_NO_HRS = P_YR_NO_HRS;
ELSIF P_CALC_TYP =3 THEN -- MONTHLY
Return (V_TMS_CNT);
Return (1);
End GET_SNCTN_TMS_CNT;
V_PRD_NO_HRS HRS_VLTN_MST.PRD_NO_HRS%TYPE;
V_YR_NO_HRS HRS_VLTN_MST.YR_NO_HRS%TYPE;
V_CALC_TYP Number;
Hrs_Gnr_Pkg.Get_Hrs_Prd_YR_No(P_DOC_DATE,V_PRD_NO_HRS,V_YR_NO_HRS);
if P_CALC_TYP is null then
V_CALC_TYP := HRS_SNCTN_PKG.GET_VLTN_CALC_TYP (P_VLTN_NO =>P_VLTN_NO);
V_CALC_TYP :=P_CALC_TYP;
ENd iF;
V_TMS_CNT:= GET_SNCTN_TMS_CNT (P_EMP_NO =>P_EMP_NO,
P_VLTN_NO =>P_VLTN_NO,
P_YR_NO_HRS =>V_YR_NO_HRS,
P_PRD_NO_HRS =>V_PRD_NO_HRS,
P_CALC_TYP =>V_CALC_TYP) ;
'Select CODE_NO,ARTCL_NO,RCRD_NO,PRD_VAL
From HRS_VLTN_LAW M
Where M.VLTN_NO = ' || P_VLTN_NO
||' AND M.TMS_CNT = ' || V_TMS_CNT
|| ' AND RowNum<=1 ';
INTO P_SNCTN_NO,
P_SNCTN_RCRD,
P_PRD_VAL;
P_TMS_CNT:=V_TMS_CNT;
SELECT MAX(TMS_CNT) INTO V_TMS_CNT FROM HRS_VLTN_LAW WHERE VLTN_NO =P_VLTN_NO;
P_ERRMSG:='BSN V_TMS_CNT '||V_TMS_CNT;
Raise_Application_Error(-20006,'Err. Getting Sanction NO.'||Sqlerrm);
--Raise_Application_Error(-20006,'Err. Getting Sanction NO.'||Sqlerrm);
P_ERRMSG:='Err. Getting Sanction NO '||Sqlerrm;
END GET_SNCTN_TMS_FLDS;
